warnings: Last sheet of the set. Two details: the septic tank (plan, cover plan and section 1-1) and the RC surface-water channel.

CONFLICT with SN-01 on tank capacity. SN-01's legend calls for precast tanks of 'ความจุรวมไม่น้อยกว่า 2 m.³' from PP/AQUA/DOS. This sheet instead details a site-built tank of stacked ø1.00 x 0.40 m market concrete rings. A ø1.00 m barrel about 1.70 m deep is roughly 1.3 m³ of wetted volume, i.e. BELOW the 2 m³ minimum SN-01 states, and the construction type differs too (concrete rings vs a proprietary PP unit). Neither sheet is overridden -- both are recorded as printed and the discrepancy is flagged here for the reviewer. The volume figure is arithmetic from the printed dimensions, not a printed value.

The vent size is given only as a minimum ('ไม่เล็กกว่า 1/2"') deferring to the building drawings, so no fixed diameter is recorded -- dia_in 0.5 is the stated floor, and the note preserves the wording.
This sheet does NOT contain the 'บ่อดักอะ (ดูแบบขยาย)' detail that SN-01 cross-references, nor any บ่อกรองไร้อากาศ detail. Both remain unresolved cross-references in the set.
building is null: the septic tank and channel details are generic and are used by the toilet block, the only part of the project with drainage drawn.
